gates.stated: Only exit 1 means an argv error

gates.reason: The sensitive-path / escaping-symlink artifact refusal is RECORDED IN THE JSON OUTPUT — the helper exits 0 and 'a refusal never aborts the round' — so it is not an exit-code or stderr signal a cli-exit recipe can assert. It already has a dedicated contract test (tests/brainstorm-artifact-context.test.mjs), but the closed oracle registry has no 'run an arbitrary test file' oracle to bind it here.

'The helper exits 0 even when providers fail or are misconfigured — read the JSON state field, not the exit code' is the complement of the executable argv-error gate above. Asserting the exit-0 direction would need a valid-topic run that reaches a configured-to-fail provider, which is not hermetically deterministic under buildHermeticEnv (keys stripped) without a live provider — so the assertable half (argv error -> exit 1) is bound executably and this direction is document-only.

Every node one-liner carries `require` and `process.exit`, two ENFORCEMENT_VERBS, and no phrasing of a runnable recipe avoids them — the verbs are JavaScript here, not an enforcement claim about this skill.
